mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_NoSelfTransfer allows a Transfer where source = destination, which directly violates the NoSelfMutation assertion. The injection forces such a transfer to exist.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_SelfTransfer { some t: Transfer | t.source = t.destination }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AuditCompleteness allows a Transfer with no AuditEntry. The injection forces such an orphan transfer to exist, violating audit completeness and fail-closed assertions.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoAudit { some t: Transfer | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.transaction = t }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AppendOnlyAuditEntries allows two distinct AuditEntry atoms to share the same seqNum, violating the append-only uniqueness invariant. The injection forces duplicate sequence numbers.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateSeq { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.seqNum = ae2.seqNum }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_OwnershipBasedAccess allows a Customer to initiate a transfer from an account they don't own. The injection forces this scenario.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OwnershipBypass { some t: Transfer | Customer in t.initiatedBy.roles and t.source not in t.initiatedBy.owns }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AuthRequiredEverywhere allows unauthenticated users to initiate transfers. The injection forces a transfer initiated by an unauthenticated user.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_UnauthTransfer { some t: Transfer | t.initiatedBy.authStatus = Unauthenticated }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AttributionCorrectness allows an audit entry's actor to differ from the transfer's initiator. The injection forces misattribution.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_Misattribution { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.actor != ae.transaction.initiatedBy }
